decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the product feed, immediately excluding several items that were actually travel cases or charging cables rather than speakers. My consideration set represents a mix of reputable brands (Bose, JBL), budget value (EDUPLINK), and unique form factors (Monster neckband, Tenmiya boombox style). I selected the Bose SoundLink Color II as the final choice because it has an overwhelming amount of positive social proof (over 62,000 reviews at a 4.6 rating) and offers a reliable balance of portability, water resistance, and high-quality audio from a trusted brand at a mid-range price point of $124.95.
